description: Optional configuration for envguard. Every key is optional except version.

files.description: Glob patterns of real env files for this environment.

templates.description: Glob patterns of env templates for this environment.

environments.description: Map environment names to env files and templates whose names envguard cannot infer (e.g. deploy/prod.env). Overrides the built-in .env.<name> inference for matching files.

exclude.description: Glob patterns of files or directories to skip, in addition to .gitignore and the built-in excludes (node_modules, vendor, dist, ...). Patterns without a slash match names anywhere.

fail_on.description: Lowest severity that makes envguard exit with code 1 (never: always exit 0 unless envguard itself fails). Overridden by --fail-on. Default: error.

ignore.description: Suppress findings matching a rule, a path glob and/or a variable name.

path.description: Glob of files the suppression applies to (relative to the root, ** supported).

reason.description: Why this is suppressed (for reviewers; not used by envguard).

rule.description: Rule ID to suppress, e.g. EG004. Omit to suppress every rule.

variable.description: Variable name the suppression applies to. * matches any sequence of characters.

include.description: Glob patterns (relative to the root, ** supported). When set, only matching files are analyzed. Patterns without a slash match file names anywhere.

rules.description: Per-rule severity overrides, keyed by rule ID. Use off to disable a rule.

ignore_variables.description: Variable names the scanner should ignore, e.g. variables provided by the platform. * matches any sequence of characters.

languages.description: Languages to scan. Default: all supported languages.

default.description: Documented default value. Must be valid for the type.

environments.description: Environments in which required applies. Default: all environments.

pattern.description: Regular expression (Go RE2 syntax) the value must match; it is searched, so anchor with ^ and $ for a full match.

production.description: Extra constraints in the production environment (rule EG015).

must_be.description: The value must equal this in production (compared by type: for bool, off equals false).

must_not_be.description: The value must not equal this in production (compared by type).

pattern.description: Regular expression the value must match in production.

required.description: The variable must be set (in the listed environments, or everywhere). Default: false.

schemes.description: Allowed URL schemes (type url only), e.g. [postgres, postgresql].

sensitive.description: Always mask the value, even if the name looks harmless.

type.description: Value type. Default: string. bool accepts true/false, 1/0, yes/no, on/off (case-insensitive); duration uses Go syntax (300ms, 1h30m).

values.description: Allowed values (required for type enum, only allowed there).

variables.description: Schema of environment variables, keyed by variable name.

title: EnvGuard configuration (.envguard.yaml)
